natural: see clearly ten thousand li away

meaning.en: Sharp vision or insight that sees things far away or far ahead.
meaning.zh: 眼力敏锐，看得很远；比喻有远见卓识。

examples.zh: 他明见万里，早早就预见了行业的变化。
examples.en: With his keen foresight he saw the industry's changes early.

examples.zh: 好的领导者须明见万里，不能只看眼前。
examples.en: A good leader must see far ahead and not just what is in front of him.

usage.en: Praise, literary; for foresight rather than literal eyesight. Rare in speech.
usage.zh: 褒义，文学色彩浓，指远见，口语少用。

meaning.en: To suddenly understand a whole subject after long thought, with everything falling into place.
meaning.zh: 经过长期思考或积累，忽然领悟了全部道理。

equivalents: a sudden flash of full understanding

examples.zh: 反复琢磨之后，他对这道题豁然贯通。
examples.en: After mulling it over again and again, the whole problem suddenly made sense to him.

examples.zh: 读完整本书，我对这门学科豁然贯通。
examples.en: After finishing the whole book, the entire subject suddenly came together for me.

usage.en: Positive; about sudden understanding after long effort. 豁 is read huò here, not huō.
usage.zh: 褒义，指长期积累后的顿悟。“豁”读huò。

natural: set out at dawn, rest at night

meaning.en: To travel by day and rest at night; a long journey, hurried along.
meaning.zh: 天亮就赶路，天黑就住宿，形容旅途辛苦，抓紧赶路。

examples.zh: 商队晓行夜宿，历时三月才到达边城。
examples.en: The caravan travelled from dawn each day and took three months to reach the border town.

examples.zh: 他们晓行夜宿，一路向西。
examples.en: They pressed on day after day, heading west.

usage.en: Literary, about travel on a long road, often with 风餐露宿.
usage.zh: 文学色彩浓，多写长途旅行，常与“风餐露宿”连用。

meaning.en: A solid, united whole that cannot be broken from outside, or a group that has no cracks inside.
meaning.zh: 像一整块铁板，比喻内部团结牢固，也指不可分割、不可渗透。

examples.zh: 对外，他们是铁板一块，没有人能钻空子。
examples.en: Outwardly they are a solid bloc, and no one can exploit a gap.

examples.zh: 别以为他们内部是铁板一块，其实矛盾不少。
examples.en: Don't assume they are a monolith; there are many internal tensions.

usage.en: Can be praise (united) or a warning (impervious to others); usually used in a negative: 并非铁板一块.
usage.zh: 可褒可贬，常见于否定式“并非铁板一块”。

literal: search · search · look for · look for

meaning.en: Searching again and again, usually for something lost or an elusive feeling.
meaning.zh: 一遍又一遍地寻找，常含有失落、寂寞的心情。

examples.zh: 她在人群中寻寻觅觅，想找到那熟悉的身影。
examples.en: She searched among the crowd for that familiar figure.

examples.zh: 寻寻觅觅这么多年，他终于找到了答案。
examples.en: After searching for so many years, he finally found the answer.

story.en: The poem opens: 'Searching, searching, seeking and seeking; cold, cold, quiet, quiet; sorrow, sorrow, misery, misery' (寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚).
story.zh: “寻寻觅觅，冷冷清清，凄凄惨惨戚戚。”

usage.en: Literary and wistful; strongly associated with Li Qingzhao's poem. Describes the act of searching with unease.
usage.zh: 文学色彩浓，带怅惘情绪，与李清照《声声慢》密切相关。

meaning.en: To decline to compete or argue, as when an ancient army hung a sign refusing battle.
meaning.zh: 古代作战时一方挂出牌子表示不出战；现比喻拒绝较量、回避争论。

examples.zh: 今天太累了，这盘棋我先挂免战牌。
examples.en: I'm too tired today; I'm sitting out this game of chess.

examples.zh: 他一说起股市就没完，我只好挂免战牌。
examples.en: Once he starts on the stock market he never stops, so I declined to engage.

usage.en: Casual and often humorous; a verb phrase. The 'sign' can be inserted: 挂起了免战牌.
usage.zh: 口语，常带幽默，可插入成分，如“挂起了免战牌”。

meaning.en: To put someone on a blacklist and treat them as an outcast.
meaning.zh: 把人列入另一个名册，指被视为异类或坏人而受歧视。

examples.zh: 他因为说真话被打入另册，没人敢和他往来。
examples.en: For speaking the truth he was blacklisted and no one dared to deal with him.

examples.zh: 别把犯过错的同学打入另册，要给他改正的机会。
examples.en: Don't treat a classmate who made a mistake as an outcast; give him a chance to change.

usage.en: Negative; often passive, 被打入另册. 另册 was originally the separate register of lowly households in old China.
usage.zh: 含贬义，常用被动式“被打入另册”。“另册”原指旧时记录“贱民”等的名册。

meaning.en: To meet someone briefly; to show one's face for a moment.
meaning.zh: 短暂地见一面；露个面。

examples.zh: 在会议室门口，我只和他打个照面就匆匆走了。
examples.en: I only bumped into him briefly at the meeting-room door before hurrying on.

examples.zh: 他只在聚会上打个照面就走了。
examples.en: He only showed his face at the party and then left.

usage.en: Casual; 个 is neutral-toned here, and the structure is flexible (打了个照面，打过照面). Not for a long meeting.
usage.zh: 口语，结构灵活，如“打了个照面”。不用于长时间会面。

meaning.en: A worried, furrowed brow; looking very troubled.
meaning.zh: 眉头紧皱，形容忧愁的样子。

examples.zh: 他愁眉紧锁，坐在窗前一言不发。
examples.en: With a furrowed brow he sat silently by the window.

examples.zh: 看她愁眉紧锁的样子，一定遇到了难事。
examples.en: Seeing her knitted brow, she must have run into something difficult.

usage.en: Descriptive; fine in writing and speech. Similar to 愁眉不展 but more intense.
usage.zh: 描写神情，书面和口语皆可，比“愁眉不展”语气重。

meaning.en: Walking with a firm, brisk, strong step, usually said of the old.
meaning.zh: 走路有力而敏捷，多形容老年人身体健康。

examples.zh: 七十岁的张大爷步履矫健，不输年轻人。
examples.en: At seventy, Grandpa Zhang walks with a firm step, no less than a young man.

examples.zh: 老教授步履矫健地走上讲台。
examples.en: The old professor strode up to the lectern with vigour.

usage.en: Praise for physical vigour; typically about older people. 履 is lǚ.
usage.zh: 褒义，多形容老人身体硬朗。

meaning.en: Overwhelmed by anger, rage so great that one loses control.
meaning.zh: 怒气充满胸中，难以控制。

examples.zh: 听到这个消息，他怒火攻心，一拳砸在桌上。
examples.en: On hearing the news he was consumed by rage and slammed his fist on the table.

examples.zh: 怒火攻心的他说了许多后悔的话。
examples.en: Blind with anger, he said many things he later regretted.

usage.en: Describes a state of rage; often as attributive (怒火攻心的人) or predicate, sometimes with 失去理智.
usage.zh: 描述盛怒状态，可作谓语、定语。

natural: safe and well, year after year

meaning.en: A New Year wish: may every year be safe and peaceful.
meaning.zh: 祝愿每年都平安顺利。

equivalents: may all your years be peaceful

examples.zh: 新春佳节，祝你岁岁平安。
examples.en: Happy Spring Festival; may all your years be peaceful.

examples.zh: 爸爸在除夕夜举杯，祝全家岁岁平安。
examples.en: On New Year's Eve Dad raised his glass and wished the whole family peace every year.

usage.en: A common greeting at New Year; 'smash' (碎) and 'year' (岁) are homophones, so breaking something prompts the phrase. Often combined with 年年有余.
usage.zh: 春节常用祝福语。“碎”“岁”谐音，打碎东西时常说“碎碎平安”。

meaning.en: Doors left wide open, so that there is no defence; completely exposed.
meaning.zh: 门完全打开，没有防备，比喻防守失败或毫无戒备。

examples.zh: 防线崩溃后，城池门户洞开。
examples.en: After the defences collapsed the city lay wide open.

examples.zh: 系统漏洞让公司网络门户洞开。
examples.en: The flaw left the company's network completely exposed.

usage.en: Negative, about security and defence; literal or figurative. Opposite of 固若金汤.
usage.zh: 含贬义，指防守失败，实指虚指皆可。与“固若金汤”相反。

meaning.en: To vow never to forget a person or a kindness.
meaning.zh: 发誓永远不忘。

examples.zh: 师恩难忘，学生们永矢弗谖。
examples.en: A teacher's kindness is unforgettable and the students vow never to forget it.

examples.zh: 朋友的救命之恩，我永矢弗谖。
examples.en: I will never forget my friend for saving my life.

story.en: The ode ends: 'Sleeping alone, I wake and speak; I swear never to forget' (独寐寤言，永矢弗谖).

date.zh: 西周初至春秋中叶 · 前11—前6世纪
date.en: early Western Zhou to mid Spring and Autumn, 11th–6th c. BC

usage.en: Highly literary and formal, used in dedications or speeches; 矢 means 'to vow', 谖 is xuān ('to forget').
usage.zh: 文言色彩很浓，多用于题词、致辞。“矢”指发誓，“谖”读xuān，忘记。

meaning.en: Cold, unfeeling and lacking in loyalty, especially in love or friendship.
meaning.zh: 感情淡薄，缺乏情义。

examples.zh: 他薄情寡义，毕业后就不再联系老朋友。
examples.en: He is cold-hearted and has not contacted his old friends since graduation.

examples.zh: 别爱上薄情寡义的人。
examples.en: Don't fall for someone fickle and heartless.

usage.en: Derogatory; for people, especially in romance and friendship. Reverses to 寡情薄义 with the same meaning.
usage.zh: 贬义，指人，尤指爱情友情中的冷淡。

meaning.en: One's ability or strength is not enough to do something, often used humbly to decline or apologise.
meaning.zh: 能力或力量不够，做不到。常作谦辞。

equivalents: I'm afraid it is beyond my means

examples.zh: 此事我有心相助，但力有未逮。
examples.en: I'd like to help, but it is beyond my means.

examples.zh: 这个项目对他而言，确实力有未逮。
examples.en: The project is, frankly, beyond what he can manage.

usage.en: Polite and formal, often used with 心有余而 … Pronounced dǎi, not dài. 力所不逮 is the same idiom.
usage.zh: 谦辞，书面语。“逮”读dǎi。“力所不逮”同义。

natural: pine and crane for long life

meaning.en: A birthday wish for longevity; the pine and the crane are traditional symbols of long life.
meaning.zh: 松和鹤都是长寿的象征，用于祝人长寿。

equivalents: long life, like the pine and crane

examples.zh: 爷爷八十大寿，贺联上写着“松鹤延年”。
examples.en: For Grandpa's eightieth birthday, the congratulatory scroll read 'Long life like the pine and crane'.

examples.zh: 寿堂中挂着一幅松鹤延年图。
examples.en: A painting of pine and cranes for long life hung in the birthday hall.

usage.en: A set birthday wish for the elderly, in couplets and on paintings.
usage.zh: 给老人祝寿的常用语，多见于对联、图画。

natural: a blue sky for ten thousand li

meaning.en: A blue, cloudless sky stretching a long way.
meaning.zh: 蓝天万里无云，形容天空晴朗辽阔。

equivalents: a clear blue sky as far as the eye can see

examples.zh: 今天碧空万里，适合去爬山。
examples.en: Today the sky is cloudless and blue; good for a hike.

examples.zh: 飞机穿过云层，下面是碧空万里。
examples.en: The plane broke through the clouds and a boundless blue sky lay ahead.

usage.en: Descriptive, poetic; 里 is the Chinese li (about half a km).
usage.zh: 描写天气，带诗意。

literal: poor · yet · all the more · firm

meaning.en: Becoming more resolute the harder one's circumstances become.
meaning.zh: 处境越艰难，意志越坚强。

examples.zh: 他家境贫寒，却穷且益坚，终于考上了名校。
examples.en: His family was poor, but he grew only more determined and got into a top university.

examples.zh: 真正的强者，往往穷且益坚。
examples.en: True strong people often become more resolute under hardship.

story.en: Wang Bo writes: 'Though poor, all the more firm; he will not drop his lofty aspirations' (穷且益坚，不坠青云之志).
story.zh: “老当益壮，宁移白首之心？穷且益坚，不坠青云之志。”

usage.en: Praise for perseverance; literary. Often followed by 不坠青云之志.
usage.zh: 褒义，文学色彩浓，常接“不坠青云之志”。

meaning.en: Grand plans and broad strategy.
meaning.zh: 宏大的计划和深远的谋略。

examples.zh: 这位君主胸怀宏图大略，志在统一天下。
examples.en: The ruler harboured grand designs, aiming to unify the realm.

examples.zh: 创业者既要有宏图大略，也要脚踏实地。
examples.en: An entrepreneur needs a grand vision and also a down-to-earth approach.

usage.en: Praise; formal and literary, stresses strategy and statecraft more than 宏图大志. 略 is lüè.
usage.zh: 褒义，书面语，较“宏图大志”更强调谋略。

meaning.en: To be chosen as a son-in-law; or more generally, to be selected.
meaning.zh: 原指被选为女婿，后泛指被选中。

examples.zh: 他才貌出众，雀屏中选，成了名门女婿。
examples.en: Talented and handsome, he was chosen to marry into a distinguished family.

examples.zh: 这位年轻教授雀屏中选，担任新项目负责人。
examples.en: The young professor was chosen to lead the new project.

story.en: Dou Yi painted two peacocks on a screen and let suitors shoot arrows at them; Li Yuan (later Emperor Gaozu) hit each peacock in the eye and won his daughter.
story.zh: 窦毅画二孔雀于屏，求婚者射箭，李渊两发各中一目，遂得娶之。

usage.en: Literary and a little playful; the figurative 'selected' sense is rarer. 屏 is píng, 中 is zhòng (hit).
usage.zh: 文学色彩浓，略带幽默；泛指“被选中”较少见。“中”读zhòng。

meaning.en: With many people around, you can't avoid being seen; so be discreet.
meaning.zh: 人多，眼睛多，容易被人看见，需要谨慎。

examples.zh: 这里人多眼杂，我们换个地方谈。
examples.en: There are too many eyes around here; let's talk somewhere else.

examples.zh: 贵重物品别放在显眼处，人多眼杂的。
examples.en: Don't leave valuables in plain sight; there are lots of people around.

usage.en: Casual, mostly in warnings; companion to 人多嘴杂 (many mouths, gossip) but about being seen.
usage.zh: 口语，多用于提醒谨慎；“人多嘴杂”侧重闲话。
